blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) Chairman Al Haj Murad Ebrahim has asked to meet with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on implementing the Bangsamoro peace agreement. In a letter dated October 1 through Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, Ebrahim requested a meeting with the President, together with representatives of the MILF leadership, “at a time convenient to you.” He signed the letter as MILF chairman, president of the United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP), and member-elect of the incoming regular Bangsamoro Parliament.
